title: Route Operations
description: Core operations for route manipulation: Pipe between two points to create a knot, Grow a knot by one point, Pipe between two knots to create a higher-order knot, Grow a knot by another knot (cutting through), Collapse two linked paths into one knot (converting double pipes to single).
definition-of-done: All five route operations implemented. Operations update hierarchy correctly. Visual feedback during operations. Undo capability for operations.
testing-plan: Test each operation produces correct result. Verify hierarchy updates correctly. Test visual feedback. Verify undo works.
todos: Create grow operation (add point to knot)
